tools.name: check_token
tools.description: Token risk check (rug check, honeypot, scam token, memecoin / pump.fun safety) for one Base or Solana token. Free tool: returns risk_level, pass/warn/fail counts and 4 headline flags with raw values, plus the x402 URL for the full report ($0.0009 USDC on Base: GET /v1/check?token=chain:address; chea

tools.name: check_token_risk
tools.description: Same as check_token with explicit chain + address: free token risk preview (rug check / honeypot / scam screen) for one Base or Solana token. Full report via x402: $0.0009 per token (GET /v1/check) or $0.015 for 1-10 tokens (POST /v1/risk).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_token, check_token_risk · Private data: check_token, check_token_risk · Public sink: check_token_risk.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_token, check_token_risk · Private data: check_token, check_token_risk · Public sink: check_token_risk

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
